description: This file defines the class PhotoDownloadRunnable, a Java Runnable that handles downloading image data from a URL asynchronously. It includes inner interface TaskRunnableDownloadMethods for interaction with a managing task, handles HTTP connections, reads image data, reports download status, and manages thread interruptions.

classes.name: PhotoDownloadRunnable
classes.description: A Runnable class that manages downloading image bytes from a URL, communicates download states, and handles thread interruption.

methods.name: PhotoDownloadRunnable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the runnable with a reference to the photo task managing the download.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the download process: sets thread priority, manages HTTP connection, reads image data into buffer, updates task state, and handles thread interruptions and cleanup.
